name: Glide Video Toolkit
overview: 服务器视频方向与批量文件整理
description: For Jellyfin 12.2 on Linux Docker. Server-side MP4/MOV/M4V rotation, durable serial queues, updated preview frames and verified backup restore. Adds separately authorized home-video move, recycle and restore. Requires explicit user authorization and writable library paths. No video transfer through the phone.

versions.changelog: Batch home-video move, recoverable deletion and restore with durable serial tasks, same-name protection, subtitle sidecars and folder index refresh. File management is disabled until separately authorized by an administrator.
Independent repository and Jellyfin catalog installation. Retains the 1.1.0 rotation engine, configuration, backups and task history.
